problem_parameters.knapsack_capacity: <float> Total capacity of the knapsack available for production and repair activities.
problem_parameters.uncertainty_budget: <float> Maximum total degradation the adversary can impose across all items.

items.weight: <int> Capacity consumed when the item is produced.
items.nominal_profit: <float> Profit earned from the item when there is no degradation.
items.max_degradation: <float> Worst-case profit reduction for the item when its degradation factor equals one.
items.outsource_penalty: <float> Cost penalty incurred when the item is outsourced instead of produced in-house.
items.repair_capacity: <float> Additional capacity consumed when the item is repaired to recover its full nominal profit.
